description:
Private, offline Bristol stool diary with CSV export.
Poop Log is a simple bowel-movement tracker built around the Bristol Stool Form Scale. It has no account, ads, analytics, cloud sync, or internet permission. Your entries stay on your device unless you explicitly export them to CSV.

Record each movement with one tap: pick the Bristol type and optionally add quantity, urgency, blood, pain, color, and notes. Review entries by day or month, browse local trend summaries, and export everything as a plain CSV file whenever you choose.

No internet permission
